page.overview:
Who is Brown Wing?

Brown Wing is a supplemental mutant character in Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles & Other Strangeness by Palladium Books. He is not associated with any particular pre-written role-playing scenario. Brown Wing is a member of the Sparrow-Eagles, a team of three teenage mutant ninja sparrows.

Brown Wing is a fast-thinking planner, able to rapidly devise and discard plans.

After assisting local and state police during a perilous hostage situation, the Sparrow-Eagles are in good standing with them. However, the FBI is currently investigating the Sparrow-Eagles as a follow-up to claims that they are some sort of government agents, which they are not.
